text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Takarazuka Kinen approaches. The 
strongest Umamusume in both skill and 
popularity gather together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A path different from Mejiro Ramonu's. 
Some in the audience questioned whether 
she could show her strength against rivals 
who had fought through the Classic Triple 
Crown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, that very atmosphere was the 
ultimate spice to test her love. Stoking 
even the skeptical spectators, she strode 
toward the battleground.
